Credentials live in the linked Integration, not in this config. Mirrors
`DatabricksBatchExportInputs` in `products/batch_exports/backend/service.py`.

use_automatic_schema_evolution.description: Whether to let Databricks evolve the destination table schema automatically.

use_variant_type.description: Whether to use the Databricks VARIANT type for JSON-like columns.

integration_id.description: ID of a databricks-kind Integration. Use the integrations-list MCP tool to find one.

compression.description:
Optional compression codec applied to exported files. Valid codecs depend on file_format.

* `brotli` - brotli
* `gzip` - gzip
* `lz4` - lz4
* `snappy` - snappy
* `zstd` - zstd

file_format.description:
File format used for exported objects.

* `JSONLines` - JSONLines
* `Parquet` - Parquet

legacy_parquet_extension.description: Whether Parquet files keep the compression codec in their extension, for example '.parquet.zst' rather than '.parquet'. Parquet records its codec inside the file, so new exports leave it out. An export that already wrote Parquet files before this setting existed keeps it, so that pipelines matching on the old names do not break. Has no effect on JSON Lines, which always carries the codec in its extension.

max_file_size_mb.description: If set, rolls to a new file once the current file exceeds this size in MB.

prefix.description: Object key prefix applied to every exported file.

integration_id.description: ID of an azure-blob-kind Integration. Use the integrations-list MCP tool to find one.

anyOf.description: Request shape for creating or updating a Redshift batch-export destination.

config.description:
Typed configuration for a Redshift batch-export destination.

Connection credentials may live in a linked Integration (when one is provided) or inline in
this config (legacy). Mirrors the non-credential fields of `RedshiftBatchExportInputs` in
`products/batch_exports/backend/service.py`.

copy_inputs.description: S3 staging configuration, required when mode is 'COPY'.

anyOf.description: ARN of an IAM role attached to the Redshift cluster.

authorization.description: Authorization for Redshift to read staged files during COPY: the ARN of an IAM role attached to the cluster, inline AWS credentials, or the id of an aws-s3-kind Integration.

bucket_credentials.description: Credentials used to stage files in the S3 bucket: inline AWS credentials or the id of an aws-s3-kind Integration.

region_name.description: AWS region of the staging S3 bucket.

s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket where files are staged before the Redshift COPY.

s3_key_prefix.description: Key prefix for staged files in the S3 bucket.

database.description: Redshift database name to connect to.

host.description: Redshift cluster or Serverless workgroup endpoint. Required when using an AWS Redshift integration; plain Redshift integrations store the host themselves.

mode.description:
How rows reach Redshift: batched INSERT statements, or COPY from files staged in S3.

* `INSERT` - INSERT
* `COPY` - COPY

port.description: Port the Redshift server listens on.

properties_data_type.description:
Data type used for JSON-like columns such as event properties.

* `varchar` - varchar
* `super` - super

schema.description: Redshift schema name containing the destination table.

table_name.description: Redshift table name to write exported rows into.

integration_id.description: ID of an aws-redshift-kind Integration providing connection credentials. Use the integrations-list MCP tool to find one.

destination.description: Destination configuration. Required integration_id is enforced per destination type.

cookielessTrafficIsRegular.description: Do not treat a missing user agent as automation on cookieless events. Positive bot signals and custom project rules still apply. Resolved server-side; not intended to be set by clients.

combiner.description: Whether every condition must match (AND) or any one of them (OR).

key.description: The event property this condition reads.

pattern.description: Matched against the property named by `key`.

name.description: Reported by `$virt_bot_name` and `$virt_bot_operator` when the rule matches.

forceClickhouseDataSkippingIndexes.description: If these are provided, the query will fail if these skip indexes are not used

mergeFederatedAggregateJoins.description: Merge sibling aggregating LEFT JOINs over federated Postgres tables into one UNION ALL join, so their scans overlap

parserMode.description: HogQL parser backend; absent → `rust_py_with_cpp_shadow` (rust-py is primary, cpp runs as a sampled shadow). `*_shadow` modes return the primary result and sample-compare against the other parser, reporting divergences without failing the request. The `rust_py_*` modes drive the same hand-rolled Rust parser as `rust_*` but build `posthog.hogql.ast` dataclass instances directly via PyO3, skipping the JSON round-trip.

sessionIdPushdown.description: Push a `session_id_v7 IN (SELECT … FROM events WHERE …)` predicate into the raw_sessions subquery to limit aggregation to sessions that participate in the outer events filter.

sessionPropertyPreAggregation.description: Pre-filter raw_sessions aggregation by `session_id_v7 IN (cheap pre-aggregation that only materializes the columns referenced by the outer-WHERE session predicate)`. Useful when the breakdown/SELECT pulls in many session columns (e.g. `$channel_type`) but the filter only references one (e.g. `$entry_current_url`).

typeAwareCastSimplification.description: Remove provably redundant casts and nullability wrappers (e.g. `toString(String)`, `assumeNotNull(non_nullable)`, dead `ifNull` fallbacks) using inferred expression types

usePreaggregatedTableTransforms.description: Try to automatically convert HogQL queries to use preaggregated tables at the AST level *

webAnalyticsFirstPageviewFilters.description: Serve filters on the stored session-entry attribution properties (`$channel_type`, `$entry_utm_*`, `$entry_referring_domain`) by recomputing the value from the session's first pageview. Resolved server-side; not intended to be set by clients.

hogql_modifiers.description: HogQL modifiers to use when the query runs. Only supported when 'model' is 'hogql'. Each modifier set here overrides the project modifier with the same name, and the project modifiers apply to all others. For example, set convertToProjectTimezone to false to export timestamps in UTC instead of the project timezone.

hogql_query.description: HogQL SELECT query. With model 'hogql', its results are the data exported by every run. The query may reference the {data_interval_start} and {data_interval_end} placeholders, replaced with each run's data interval bounds, for example: WHERE timestamp >= {data_interval_start} AND timestamp < {data_interval_end}. Without them every run exports all rows the query returns. With model 'events', it defines a custom schema of columns to export instead. Required when model is 'hogql'.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this batch export.

interval.description:
How often the batch export should run.

* `hour` - hour
* `day` - day
* `week` - week
* `every 5 minutes` - every 5 minutes
* `every 15 minutes` - every 15 minutes

model.description:
Which data model to export: events, persons, sessions, or hogql. The hogql model exports the results of hogql_query.

* `events` - Events
* `persons` - Persons
* `sessions` - Sessions
* `hogql` - Hogql

name.description: Human-readable name for the batch export.

offset_hour.description: Hour-of-day offset (0-23) for daily and weekly intervals.

paused.description: Whether the batch export is paused.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC') controlling daily and weekly interval boundaries.
